d:
The excitement for Mohra is building up! Before the film arrives, turn up the nostalgia and enjoy one of its most iconic chartbusters – Tu Cheez Badi Hai Mast Mast!
Featuring the sizzling chemistry of Akshay Kumar and Raveena Tandon, this unforgettable dance number is brought to life by the energetic voice of Udit Narayan and the music of Viju Shah.
